components.name: Chart/Calendar heatmap
components.description: Daily activity over a year (Year, GitHub-style) or a month (Month). Colour = amount on dataviz/sequential (200 · 300 · 500 · 700), zero = dataviz/track; always show the Less → More scale. Weeks start on Monday. Mobile: Year scrolls horizontally with sticky weekday labels. React: <CalendarHeatmap data={[{ date, value }]} range="year|month" />
